map.输入标准不确定度 u 与测得值 x，按 u_rel = u / |x| 计算相对: Enter the standard uncertainty u and the measured value x and the relative uncertainty is computed as u_rel = u / |x|, a dimensionless ratio. It suits expressing measurement precision as a percentage, such as reporting a relative expanded uncertainty.
map.输入标准不确定度 u 与测得值 x，求相对不确定度。: Enter the standard uncertainty u and the measured value x to get the relative uncertainty.
map.：U_rel = U / |y| * 100%。例：y=100.0、U=0.5，: U_rel = U / |y| * 100%. Example: y=100.0 and U=0.5 gives U_rel=0.5%.
map.：u_rel=0.2/|25|×100%=0.800%。相对不确定度便于在不同量: u_rel=0.2/|25|×100%=0.800%. The relative uncertainty makes it easy to compare precision across measurements of different magnitudes.

map.便于跨量程比较、对数量级。: Makes it easy to compare across ranges and orders of magnitude.
map.绝对值小处相对更大，需注明。: Where the absolute value is small the relative value is larger, so it has to be stated.
